@title: FORMAI — personal coach for gym, running, cycling and nutrition
@desc: A coach that asks you questions and agrees on a realistic plan with you — gym, running or cycling. Nutrition follows your training. Basic is free.
@ogt: FORMAI — gym, running or cycling. Your plan, your way.
@ogd: A coach that agrees on a realistic week with you — and nutrition that follows your training.
h1:
Gym, running or cycling.
Your plan, your way.
lead: Tell it what you want — a lean, strong body, more endurance or faster riding. The coach asks what it needs to know and agrees on a realistic week with you. Your nutrition follows your training.
note: A few minutes · Basic is free · no card needed
works: Your workouts come in on their own — Garmin, Wahoo and Strava directly, COROS, Polar and Suunto via the free intervals.icu. No watch? Just tick them off or log them.
sub1: Your plan isn't a PDF pulled out of a drawer. You agree on it together — then every workout adjusts it going forward.
p3_1: Pick with a tap or say it your way, even by voice: the body you want, gym, running or cycling, how much time you have and when you don't.
p3_2: One question at a time, different every time — based on what you've told it. Tap an answer or type your own.
p3_3: It suggests a realistic week. Ask for more, less or something different, tap a day when you're busy — until it's yours.
p3_4: In a few minutes you have your week, exercises, calories and 12 weeks ahead. Then it adapts to every workout.
h2b: As much as you need. Exactly as agreed.
sub2: One person only goes to the gym, another runs, a third rides. Your plan is whatever you agree on — just gym, just cardio, just cycling or all of it, on as many days as you have.
li1: Your goals: a lean, strong body, visible abs, more muscle, endurance, losing weight without losing muscle.
li2: Your time: how many days and minutes — and which days don't work for you.
li3: Your equipment: a gym, dumbbells at home or just your bodyweight.
ch2: CoachI'll move the run to Wednesday — the week stays at 5 days, and the heavy sets stay while you're losing weight.
p3_5: Exercises for your equipment, with sets, reps and weights. Hit all your reps and the weight goes up next time.
p3_6: Easy runs, intervals and hills. By heart rate or by feel — your endurance grows without wearing you out.
p3_7: Your season's races, watts and FTP, fueling on the bike. Peak form for every goal, with base and build in between.
h2c: Everything a coach does. Every day.
p3_8: Exercise by exercise, with a rest timer. Runs and rides step by step, with a beep before each change.
p3_9: Planned workouts go to your Garmin or Wahoo — directly or via intervals.icu.
p3_10: Log your sets as you train. See your progress per exercise, your records and the muscles you've trained this week.
p3_11: Ask anything. It answers with your numbers — sets, kilometers, grams and dates — in English.
p3_12: Weight, fitness and form in one place, plus FTP and W/kg for cyclists — and whether you're on track for your goal.
p3_13: Three taps in the morning. When your body is tired, it offers an easier day and moves the session.
h2d: Calories that know how you trained.
sub3: Most apps give you one number for every day. But a training day and a day at your desk aren't the same day.
li4: Your target moves with your training — you eat more on workout days and less on rest days.
li5: Lose weight without losing muscle: a moderate deficit and enough protein. Cyclists also get fueling for the bike.
li6: Snap or describe a meal and get an estimate of its calories and macros.
li7: Guardrails you can't skip: never below your basal metabolic rate, never below 1,500 kcal (men) or 1,200 kcal (women), no deficit under 18, and a deficit of at most 750 kcal a day.
f_note: 32 g of protein to go — cottage cheese or yogurt after your workout. Today’s deficit is 350 kcal, so your muscles stay.
disc: FORMAI is not a medical device and does not replace a doctor or dietitian.
p3_14: Workouts, meals and your plan are stored on your device. Sign in with Google and they sync across your devices. Your GPS track never goes to the AI and stays on your device (the exception is Garmin Connect — see privacy).
h3_15: The AI gets only what it needs
p3_15: Your preferences, workout numbers, meal descriptions, and the photos of meals and workouts you send — no name, email or routes. Workouts from Strava never go to the AI.
p3_16: We don't sell your data or share it for advertising. The AI (Google Gemini, and with Pro also Anthropic Claude, paid tier) doesn't use it for training.
sub4: FORMAI is new and grows with its first users. Once a week it asks you one thing — one click: A, B, C or D. You can skip it. Your answers decide what comes next.
a1: No. You tick off or log a workout in seconds. From a Garmin or Wahoo watch (directly), other watches (via the free intervals.icu), Strava or files (.fit, .gpx), workouts come in on their own. A power meter is only for cycling and isn’t required — without one, you ride by heart rate and feel.
q2: I only go to the gym. Is this for me?
a2: Yes. Your plan is whatever you agree on: exercises for your equipment, with sets, reps and weights. Log what you do during your workout, and next time the weight goes up. Machine taken? Swap the exercise with one tap.
q3: I want to lose weight, but not muscle.
a3: The deficit is moderate, there’s enough protein and the heavy sets stay — that’s how your body keeps its muscle. If your weight drops too fast, the app warns you.
a4: Connect it under Import — workouts from the last 7 days come in on their own and count toward your food target. Under Strava’s rules, the AI coach doesn’t read them; for a coach with all your data, connect your watch via intervals.icu or Garmin Connect. You can import your older Strava archive from a file.
q5: I ride and have several races. Does that work?
a5: Yes. Enter all your season’s races and how important they are. For A goals the plan builds your peak form, before B races it shortens the week, and C races you ride as training.
q6: Does it work on my phone?
a6: Yes. Open formai.si and choose “Add to Home Screen” — it opens like an app, without the address bar. On your computer you get the same account and a wider view.
a7: I calculate your target from your height, weight, age, sex and the energy you burn in training. Without this data I don’t show a number — better nothing than a guess. The guardrails always apply. Estimates are approximations; if you have health issues, talk to a doctor or dietitian.
a8: FORMAI is free, no card needed: plan, nutrition, guidance and AI with a daily limit (Basic). If you want more, there’s the FORMAI Pro subscription — more AI and the Claude coach for €6.99 a month or €59.99 a year. You see the price before you buy, and you can cancel any time in Settings.
a9: No. FORMAI gives coaching guidance and is not a medical device. If you have pain, an illness or health issues, talk to a doctor.
h2h: Your plan in a few minutes.
